question: The first urban settlement to reach a population of one million was _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**London.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **first urban settlement to reach a population of one million** was the city of **London **by around. A.D. **1810**.
 
• It was followed by **Paris **in **1850**, **New York** in **1860**, and by 1950 there were around 80 such cities.
 
• The rate of increase in the number of million cities has been three-fold in every three decades – around 160 in 1975 to around 438 in 2005.
 
• **London **is the city and **capital **of the **United Kingdom**.
 
 
• It is located 50 miles (80 km) upstream from the **River Thames'**s estuary on the **North Sea**, in southeast **England**.
 
• In the past, London originated from three main locations: the walled community established by the Romans in the first century CE on the banks of the Thames, now called the City of London, "**the Square Mile**," or simply "**the City**"; the suburb of Southwark, which is located across the bridge on the lower gravels of the south bank; and the City of Westminster, which is located one mile upstream on a large southward bend of the river.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In his seminal essay **"Cities as systems within systems of cities,"** **Brian J.L. Berry **(1964) established the** idea of the urban system**.

 
 
• The concept of urban hierarchy takes into account the differences in population sizes and economic roles among** metropolitan areas**.
 
• The primary focus of the examination of urban hierarchy is the ranking of cities according to many factors, including retail sales, industrial worker count, population size, and economic power.
 
• Rapid urbanization is a relatively new development. Few communities had populations of more than a few thousand people up until recently.
 
• The city of **London **became the **first urban community to have a million residents by the year 1810**. 
 
 
 
• Any **city **with a** population of more than 10 million people**, including its suburbs, is referred to as a **Mega city** or **megalopolis**.
 
 
• **New York**, which had a population of roughly 12.5 million, was the** first to become a megacity by 1950**.
